text: Bake isn't the word we use for zirconia. That middle stage should say Sinter.
Sinter in place of Bake please.
I've got the trainees coming in on Thursday and I'd rather teach them the right terminology from the start. Could you change the wording in the furnace step to Sinter?
that bake box can u call it Sinter thats what the sheet says
Between milling and finishing, you've written Bake. We need Sinter written there instead, thank you.
If it doesn't fit we mill it again. Show an arrow back from Fit check to Milling.
Need the return route as well: fit check back to the mill.
This makes it look as though every crown passes first time, which would be lovely. Can there be another arrow leaving the check and going back to Milling?
from the middle one a way back to milling please with the arrow pointing at milling
Please add a connection in the reverse direction between these two steps, starting at Fit check and ending at Milling. That's our remake loop.
The furnace looks like a toaster on this. Make it bigger please.
Larger sintering furnace box.
Would you enlarge the thing between the scanner and the finishing bench? We need to allow rather more room for the furnace.
can the sintering bit take up more space on the plan it's much too small at the moment
I measured the equipment this morning. You've underestimated the furnace, so increase the size of its rectangle.
We've left the dry bags off. Add a box underneath Kit saying Dry bags.
Dry bags below Kit, in their own rectangle.
People can borrow bags for their phones as well. Could you give those a place on here, a box marked Dry bags just under the kit one?
under kit can we have another of those boxes and the words Dry bags in it cheers
Please draw a rectangle for Dry bags. Below the central kit area would be the right spot.
Patel's cancelled the two o'clock. Take that booking off the board.
Remove the 14:00 Patel card please.
I've just refunded the afternoon hire; they can't make it because of the train strike. The Patel entry on the right can go altogether.
no more patel booking delete that whole box
Could you clear the last slot's booking from this drawing? The one with Patel written in it, at fourteen hundred.
The runner beans are back in stock, make their card green.
Green for Runner beans please.
Mary brought a jar of runner bean seed in this morning. That left-hand red entry ought to be green now, like Peas.
could you change the colour on the runner beans to green? red means we've run out and we haven't
Please recolour the box labelled Runner beans in green to indicate availability.
Peas, beans and lentils together as Pulses, please.
Can those three on the left be one group called Pulses? That's peas and beans and lentils.
For the school visit I want a Pulses group containing the pea, bean and lentil entries. Keep the lettuce separate.
make a group out of beans lentils peas name it Pulses
The pea and bean cards belong with the lentils. Would you collect all three into a group, with Pulses as its name?
How many of the circles are green?
Green is what we've got seed for. What's the total available on this board?
count the green ones for me pls
I'm putting together the newsletter and need a number rather than a list. How many green entries do we have showing here?
Could you tell me the number of seed types marked in green, please?
Wash and Inspection are the wrong way round. Swap their places.
The wash should occupy the inspection spot, and inspection should go where you've drawn the wash.
We enter the depot from the other side to what you think. Please exchange the two upper bays so it's wash on the left and inspection on the right.
wash over to the left where inspection is and inspection across to the old wash place thanks
Those top two need to trade positions. Washing is on the west side of our building, so it belongs in the left-hand space currently used by Inspection.
Delete the arrow that skips the brake test.
There mustn't be a direct connection from Workshop arrival to Ready for service. Please take that one out.
What's that shortcut doing on there? Nobody gets to go straight back into service. Lose the arrow running all the way from the first box to the last.
remove arrival to ready link the direct one i mean
The path through Brake test is fine. It's the extra arrow bypassing it that needs removing, so arrival no longer points straight to Ready for service.
